title: Grassification Maldegem roadside mowing-head field-test reference dataset
description: Selected tabular and explicit textual observations from Grassification deliverable D1.1.2 comparing a Vandaele modified flail mowing head with a Herder horizontal rotary Eco mower at Dijkstraat, Maldegem, on 18 June 2019. Includes site/run dimensions, short-run speeds, cutting widths/heights, container capacities, dry matter, sand content, and fibre-length distributions.
source_title: D1.1.2 Report: Testing & comparison of performance new type of mowing head against existing mowing heads
contributors: Nathalie Devriendt, Innec; Dominique Cammaert, Delphy; Cor van Oers, Delphy; Marcella Fernandes de Souza, UGent
source_location: PDF pages 11–21; site trial and machine descriptions pp. 11–14; speed/container pp. 19–20; grass quality/fibre classes pp. 20–21
license: No explicit reuse license identified in the public deliverable. Attribution retained; confirm reuse terms before broader redistribution.
applicability: Direct operational roadside mowing trial; useful for empirical ranges and equipment/harvest-quality comparisons. It is a Belgian one-day, one-corridor test and cannot establish annual yields, Dutch conditions, or a general machine performance curve.
conversion_and_scaling: Numeric transcriptions are unchanged. Measurement units and basis are retained in each row. No conversion from container volume to mass, machine travel speed to field capacity, or cut width to effective swath was performed.
uncertainty: Several table ± values lack a declared statistical meaning or replication count. Speeds are two 300 m runs per machine only. Vandaele sand content is reported as 2.8 ± 0.8% DM in Table 4 and 2.9 ± 0.8% DM in prose; both statements are retained as separate source-located records. Container fill is an operator estimate. Trace-metal and nutrient charts were not digitized.
provenance_note: Factual tabular extraction only; this evidence does not override active feedstock, harvest, transport, pretreatment, or equipment values.
